2aggha
m.n. [S. argha, arghya], hospitality, respectful reception of a guest; an offering of water etc to a guest; Abh 424 (~am agghiyaṃ); 1048 (~o … pūjane); D II 240,17* (āsanaṃ udakaṃ pajjaṃ madhupākaṃ ca brahmuno ~e bhavantaṃ pucchāma; cf Sv 664,.16 : idaṃ paribhuñjathā ti vadanto ~e bhavantaṃ pucchāmā ti ādiṃ āha) ≠ Ja IV 396,8* (396,9´ : ~e ti atithino dātabbayuttakasmiṃ ~e bhavantaṃ āpucchāma) ≠ 476,30* (477,6´ : ~e ti ime sabbe pi āsanādayo ~e bhavantaṃ pucchāma); — agghaṃ karoti, accepts as a guest-offering; D II 240,17* (~aṃ kurutu no bhavaṃ; cf Sv 664,.8 : ~an ti atithino upanāmetabbaṃ vuccati) ≠ Ja IV 396,8* (396,10´ : imaṃ no ~aṃ bhavaṃ paṭigaṇhātu) ≠ 476,30*; — see also agghiya2.
